review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Point checksum sidecar at archive's actual path**

Running packet's committed verification command from repository root fails because sidecar names `TP-DMX-FDOS-004-CHATGPT-PROJECT-SOURCE-REFRESH.zip`, while archive lives under `out/chatgpt-project-upload-set/`. Checked local `shasum --help`: `-c` reads listed sums and checks each recorded file name; actual command reports `No such file or directory` and exits 1. Record repository-relative archive path or run check from archive directory before claiming sidecar verification PASS.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L115-L133](https://github.com/DDD-Enterprises/dopemux-mvp/blob/c6e0ebd19f5e5a299512e59239d68003b9016da9/AGENTS.md#L115-L133)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Require manifest coverage for every upload file**

When manifest accidentally omits entry, validator never checks corresponding disk file. For example, deleting slot 01 entry and corrupting `01_AGENTS.md` still leaves 40 valid slot-prefixed names and makes source-identity and hash gates pass. Compare manifest slots/file names exactly against all 40 files before iterating entries, otherwise missing source identity is silently accepted instead of remaining unresolved.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L22-L24](https://github.com/DDD-Enterprises/dopemux-mvp/blob/c6e0ebd19f5e5a299512e59239d68003b9016da9/AGENTS.md#L22-L24)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Verify hashes for generated package metadata**

When slot 38 or 40 is corrupted after assembly, hash gate still passes because loop skips every non-`copied_source` entry, even though manifest records non-null SHA-256 values for both generated files. This can approve altered freshness rules or PR impact decisions; verify every manifest entry carrying non-null `sha256`, reserving exception only for self-referential slot 39.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject truncated open-PR file captures**

Current count check proves only one capture file exists per PR, not that each capture contains full changed-path set. Captures for PR #1136 and #1123 contain 100 `files` entries while recorded changed-file counts are 366 and 16,206, so selected-source or watched-path changes after API's first page cannot be classified from evidence consumed here. Compare each capture's file count with `OPEN_PRS_CHANGED_FILE_COUNTS.json` and fail closed or consume paginated paths before emitting high-confidence complete ledger.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L22-L24](https://github.com/DDD-Enterprises/dopemux-mvp/blob/c6e0ebd19f5e5a299512e59239d68003b9016da9/AGENTS.md#L22-L24)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Generate deterministic ZIP in committed assembler**

Fresh-checkout assembler returns after producing package directory and never creates ZIP or SHA-256 sidecar. Repo-wide search finds no committed archive-construction command recording fixed timestamp, ordering, permissions, or compression settings, so byte-identical ZIP claim cannot be reproduced from committed implementation; add deterministic archive and sidecar generation here or provide checked-in packaging tool.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
